items.title: Outdated Software Is an Open Door — Here Is What to Update Now
items.summary: Outdated software is the open door attackers walk through. Old versions of Adobe Reader, Java, browser plugins, and utility tools have known holes that automated scripts scan for constantly. You don't need to be targeted — just running an old version is enough.

items.title: Firefox 158 gets a fresh Nova look and brings back Compact Mode — free update at firefox.com
items.summary: Update Firefox to version 158 at firefox.com or click Menu > Help > About Firefox. The Nova redesign refreshes tabs and toolbars with a cleaner look, and Compact Mode returns to fit more on screen — just right-click the toolbar and choose Customize Toolbar > Density > Compact.

items.title: Fiber internet may already be at your Lake City address — check free on the FCC Broadband Map
items.summary: Visit broadbandmap.fcc.gov and enter your Lake City address to see every fiber, cable, and DSL provider available. ClearWave Fiber, AT&T Fiber, and Xfinity all serve parts of Columbia County — the map shows exactly what's at your doorstep.

items.title: Stop paying for Adobe Acrobat — PDF24 edits merges and splits PDFs free and offline
items.summary: Download PDF24 from pdf24.org (PCWorld's top free PDF editor pick for 2026). It works entirely offline, merges, splits, edits, converts, and adds signatures — no cloud upload, no watermark, no subscription, no account needed.

items.title: Windows 11 24H2 has known bugs — Microsoft lists workarounds at learn.microsoft.com
items.summary: Check the known issues for Windows 11 24H2 at learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/release-health/status-windows-11-24h2. Current bugs include USB audio Code 10, Remote Desktop 0xC000000D, and AC-3 audio. Microsoft provides workarounds for each.

items.title: Windows 11 23H2 Enterprise and Education lose security updates after November
items.summary: Windows 11 23H2 Enterprise and Education editions get their final security update in November 2026. Check your edition at Settings > System > About > Windows specifications. If on 23H2 Enterprise or Education, plan upgrade to 24H2 or later.

items.title: File Explorer now previews HTML files and remembers folders free in October Windows Update
items.summary: The October 2026 Windows 11 update (KB5127648) adds HTML file previews in File Explorer and remembers your folder settings. Free via Windows Update.

items.title: Stop Windows tracking free with O&O ShutUp10++ at ooshutup10.com
items.summary: O&O ShutUp10++ is a free portable tool that disables Windows telemetry, data collection, and tracking in one click. Download from ooshutup10.com.

items.title: Clearwave Fiber expands in Lake City — check eligibility at clearwavefiber.com
items.summary: Clearwave Fiber is bringing fiber internet to more Lake City neighborhoods. Visit clearwavefiber.com to check if your address qualifies for service.
